Mushroom Life Sticker Packs

Mushrooms, mushrooms, mushrooms! I love mushrooms and plants and all things nature. I have assembled this ready-to-print pack of 16 stickers for use in your journals, planners, or anywhere else. You can easily print them onto sticker paper or regular paper if you want to cut them out and use them. I am a regular paper person!

I have provided two types of stickers. The first is a plain sticker with no outer edge. The second is lined, so it will lay on the page with a slight shadow making it appear more sticker like. The purpose of this line is primarily for digital use. It helps to give the sticker a more real appearance. These stickers can be used in Goodnotes or any other journaling apps that accept PNG images. Using them at too large of a size will result in blurriness or pixelating.

Download The Mushroom Life Stickers Pack Printable PDF Here

The download link above will open the file directly in Google Drive. You do not need an account to access the file. The link will take you directly to the downloadable PDF. If you are interested in individual images or a full-sheet printable image, sign up for the Divergent Vault to get full access to all of the files.

As you can see here, my printer doesn't always match the screen. The page in person looks more green than this photo, but not really the same green as the images. For your convenience, the printable PDF files contain a test print page that includes a measurement tool as well as a single sticker so that you can test your colors before printing the entire page. I always have issues with this when I download other files. I am hyper-conscious about how much ink I waste, so I don't like printing blind!
